name: search_icons
description: Search for icons by keyword across all collections. Returns icon names in prefix:name format (e.g., "mdi:home"). Use get_icons to fetch SVG data for results.

name: get_icons
description: Get SVG code and dimensions for specific icons. Input icon names in prefix:name format (e.g., "mdi:home", "fa:star"). Returns SVG markup, width, and height.

icons.description: Comma-separated icon names within the collection (e.g., "home,arrow-left,user")

name: list_collections
description: Browse available icon collections. Returns prefix, name, icon count, author, license, and category. Use the prefix with search_icons or get_icons.
